top_signals.title: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget
top_signals.summary: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, and will include a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.
